response.justification: Bogdan is a strong, versatile senior engineer with deep open-source and Linux experience, but the resume shows only 'Basic' German against a strict C1 requirement, no explicit UML or Python experience, and no clear track record of leading or mentoring teams or owning client-facing architecture decisions — all core to this Head of Development role.
strengths: Extensive senior-level experience across web, mobile, and backend systems
Strong open-source and Linux/Unix background, including founding an open-source GIS platform
Broad technical versatility across many languages and stacks (TS, Node, DLang, C/C++, Java)
concerns: German proficiency listed as 'Basic', far below the required C1 minimum
No mention of UML, formal architecture modeling, or requirements management experience
No clear evidence of formal team leadership, client advisory, or project management responsibilities

key_factors.factor: German language level (Basic vs required C1)
Lack of demonstrated leadership/mentoring and client advisory experience
